}}'''Uren din Jubai Soaring Gull''' was an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' scholar.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Uren din Jubai Soaring Gull}}

==History==
Uren din Jubai developed the [[Farede Calendar]], which was the third common calendar of the [[Third Age]]. Uren named the calendar after [[Panarch]] [[Farede]] of [[Tarabon]], who helped spread it and standardize it.
